findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "quote_fix" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "For one to five links to PDFs on public websites, counts pages by type and returns a price estimate from CyberNative AI LLC's published Terms for two options: an accessible web page made from the PDF (USD 6 per page with tables or scanned pages, USD 4 per other page), and, where the file qualifies, " → after: "For one to five links to PDFs on public websites, checks whether each file qualifies and returns a price estimate from CyberNative AI LLC's published Terms for the same PDF with tags added: USD 4 per page, minimum USD 100 per order. Names each file that does not qualify, such as a scanned file, a fi"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
